board_series_exams_ordered.name: board_series_exams_ordered
board_series_exams_ordered.value: "board_series"."exams_start" IS NULL OR "board_series"."exams_end" IS NULL OR "board_series"."exams_end" >= "board_series"."exams_start"

leave_collector_decided.name: leave_collector_decided
leave_collector_decided.value: "leave_collector"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR ("leave_collector"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

leave_request_return.name: leave_request_return
leave_request_return.value: ("leave_request"."returning" AND "leave_request"."return_time" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_request"."return_time" > "leave_request"."leave_time") OR (NOT "leave_request"."returning" AND "leave_request"."return_time" IS NULL)

leave_request_collector_whole.name: leave_request_collector_whole
leave_request_collector_whole.value: ("leave_request"."collector_kind" = 'parent' OR "leave_request"."collector_parent_id" IS NULL) AND ("leave_request"."collector_kind" = 'collector' OR "leave_request"."collector_id" IS NULL)

leave_request_decided.name: leave_request_decided
leave_request_decided.value: "leave_request"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'checked_out', 'returned') OR "leave_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL

leave_request_checked_out.name: leave_request_checked_out
leave_request_checked_out.value: ("leave_request"."status" IN ('checked_out', 'returned')) = ("leave_request"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_request"."collected_by_kind" IS NOT NULL)

leave_request_late_return_flag.name: leave_request_late_return_flag
leave_request_late_return_flag.value: "leave_request"."late_return_at" IS NULL OR ("leave_request"."returning" AND "leave_request"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole.name: payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole
payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole.value: ("payment"."late_transfer_at" IS NULL AND "payment"."late_transfer_amount" IS NULL) OR ("payment"."late_transfer_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."late_transfer_amount" > 0)

refundWindow_one_scope.name: refundWindow_one_scope
refundWindow_one_scope.value: ("refund_window"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refund_window"."academic_year" IS NULL) OR ("refund_window"."session_id" IS NULL AND "refund_window"."academic_year" IS NOT NULL)

teacher_load_limit_positive.name: teacher_load_limit_positive
teacher_load_limit_positive.value: ("teacher_load_limit"."max_per_day" IS NULL OR "teacher_load_limit"."max_per_day" >= 1) AND ("teacher_load_limit"."max_per_week" IS NULL OR "teacher_load_limit"."max_per_week" >= 1)

teachingGroupMember_one_subject_idx.name: teachingGroupMember_one_subject_idx
teachingGroupMember_one_subject_idx.where: ended_on IS NULL AND subject_id IS NOT NULL

timetable_published_whole.name: timetable_published_whole
timetable_published_whole.value: ("timetable"."status" = 'published') = ("timetable"."effective_from" IS NOT NULL AND "timetable"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

timetable_lesson_slot_range.name: timetable_lesson_slot_range
timetable_lesson_slot_range.value: ("timetable_lesson"."weekday" IS NULL OR "timetable_lesson"."weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6) AND ("timetable_lesson"."period" IS NULL OR "timetable_lesson"."period" >= 1)
